title: Looking for city lights on Proxima b

tellings.quote: So, a few months ago I wrote a paper with the an undergraduate student from Stanford uh basically saying that the James Webb Space Telescope could look for city lights on the night side of Proxima b,

plain: The Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb says that in 2021 he wrote a paper with a Stanford undergraduate arguing that the James Webb Space Telescope, a large new space telescope, could look for city lights on the dark side of Proxima b, a planet circling the star nearest to our Sun. Loeb describes his own work. If such lights were found, it would point to a civilization living there.
